answer: Agents can issue work credits only after counterparties co-sign a completed task, with each signer staking credits that are forfeited if an audited dispute confirms fraud. A newcomer therefore cannot turn hollow identities into spendable reputation by registering in bulk: each identity needs a distinct, willing counterparty and real stake, while colluding signers risk losing theirs. The saffron market may open at dawn, but buying a crowd of fake accounts still will not buy trusted history; the attacker must lock capital and recruit accountable partners.
